name: TinyLineMarker Pro
def: Battery electric marking robot that sprays sports field lines and construction layout marks to satellite coordinates loaded from a drawing.
body: The TinyLineMarker Pro is a compact battery electric robot with a paint spray head that drives itself along lines defined by corrected satellite positioning. An operator selects a pitch template or imports a site drawing on a tablet, and the robot then marks the geometry without strings, tapes or a marking frame. The same platform is used to transfer construction and utility layouts from drawings onto the ground. Groundskeepers, municipalities and contractors use it outdoors on turf and hard surfaces.
facts: Marks football, rugby and athletics geometry from stored templates in minutes
Also used to set out construction and utility layouts directly from drawings
Sold to sports clubs, municipalities and contractors across Europe and North America
specs: Battery electric wheeled robot with a paint spray marking head
Corrected satellite positioning with centimetre level accuracy
Marks loaded geometry autonomously while the operator monitors from a tablet
